Claim tested: Do AGO1-4 have slicer/cleavage activity and do they bind miRNAs?
Key finding: Endonuclease activity exclusively AGO2; AGO4 loads miRNAs indiscriminately
Context: Human cell lines; FLAG/HA-AGO IP + cleavage reporter
Confidence/limits: High for cleavage exclusion; SILENT on deadenylation/decay

Claim tested: Can Ago proteins trigger deadenylation-dependent decay?
Key finding: All four human Ago proteins recapitulate biphasic (Pan2-Pan3 then Ccr4-Caf1) deadenylation when tethered
Confidence/limits: High that AGO4 is SUFFICIENT; artificial tethering not natural guide recruitment

Claim tested: Do nonnucleolytic Agos contribute to silencing beyond cleavage?
Key finding: Nonnucleolytic Agos (AGO1/3/4) direct translational repression; the four Agos differ significantly in capacity
Confidence/limits: Moderate; AGO4 grouped with nonnucleolytic Agos; quantitative differences noted

Claim tested: How are the two GO terms defined and what does AGO4 already carry?
Key finding: GO:0035279/0090625 definitions describe CLEAVAGE but synonyms include deadenylation; AGO4 carries GO:0035278(IDA)+GO:0006402(IDA) not the two terms
Confidence/limits: Definition/name inconsistency is the crux of the adjudication

Claim tested: Where do curators place AGO4's negative?
Key finding: Represses translation of complementary mRNAs; Lacks endonuclease activity and does not appear to cleave target mRNAs - only curated negative is MF/cleavage
Confidence/limits: Independent database-level support for re-scoping the NOT to the slicer MF
